lines: Eye-level three-quarter view from the left: all four family members, dad knocking, and the cracked orange floor tile at lower right, all visible. The boy points at the tile and the family looks amused.
Extreme close-up of the knocking fist and ring with motion lines beside a cracked orange wall tile. The family is cut out, so the family of tiles-watchers is hidden.
Wall tile is a tilted, uncracked orange square. A boy reaches up to knock while dad is cropped at the left edge and mum and girl look on, startled, from the right.
Top-down view of feet on the floor. A plain, uncracked orange rectangle sits among the tiles. There is no knocking hand and no faces, so the family and the knock are hidden.
Low, tight view of the floor. A huge cracked orange tile with shake marks fills the bottom while the boy peers down with a shocked look. Dad's knocking hand is small and cropped at the top right.
Rear view of the family walking toward a closed door. The orange cracked tile is small in the floor foreground. Dad's knocking hand is hidden and faces are not shown.
Tight crowded shot from below of three faces and dad's knocking hand, beside a cracked, vibrating orange wall tile with strong rattle lines. The shock is intense.
Like cell 1 but the door is already open, with a garden behind it. Everyone is smiling and the boy points at the floor tile. Dad's hand is on the door edge, not knocking, so the knock moment is over.
Wide side view down a corridor. The family is tiny at the far left with dad knocking, and a cracked orange wall tile with rattle lines dominates the big tiled wall.
Wide shot of the whole room with the nurse walking in through the door at far left; her nametag is too small to read, and the baby is small at right with the hose running to it.
Medium shot from the machine's side with the nurse looking down at the baby; the "Venice" tag is clearly legible and the hose visibly reaches the baby's mask.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the nurse's head; her face and nametag are hidden or cut off, but the baby, hose and machine are all visible.

High overhead angle looking down into the crib; the nametag reads "Venice" only partly (it looks like "Venza"), and the baby is shown in full with the hose across the swaddle, one of her hands on the machine.
Tight close-up with the machine filling the left half; the nurse presses a button with her finger and the "Venice" tag is clear, but the baby is cropped to the lower right corner.
Side view with the nurse reaching across to touch the machine's screen; there is no nametag at all, and the baby and hose are fully visible, with the clock and a window behind.
Front-facing, eye-level shot from the foot of the crib with the nurse behind the crib, a night window behind her and the tag legible; the baby's face with the mask is large and central.

Close-up from the baby's side with the nurse's face large at upper left; her nametag is cut off at the bottom edge (reads "Venice" only in part), the machine is cropped at the right, and the baby and hose fill the foreground.
Balanced medium shot like cell 2 but wider, with the nurse behind the crib, the "Venice" tag clear, the machine at left, the baby fully visible and the window and clock behind.

Medium side-on shot from the car's front-left: the mechanic points and shouts with an exclamation bubble while the driver leans out of the window, and the whole red bald tire is visible with its tread worn smooth.

Tight close-up on the tire: only a pointing hand and sleeve appear, with no mechanic's face, and the driver is small and distant in the window, so it shows the smooth tread most clearly but cuts off the mechanic.

Low-angle shot from the front-left: the mechanic points and the driver peers out, and the whole bald tire and the car's front are visible, with no speech bubble and a more dramatic perspective than cell 1.

Top-down bird's-eye view: the mechanic runs toward the car and the driver leans out, but the tire is a thin red sliver at the front wheel, so the bald tread is barely visible, unlike every other cell.

Over-the-mechanic's-shoulder shot: the mechanic's cap and back fill the left side, a hand points at the tire, and the driver looks alarmed in the window, with the tire cropped at the bottom and right edges.

Mechanic rushes alongside the moving car with hands up and an exclamation bubble, and the driver sits at the wheel looking stern rather than scared, which is the only cell where he does not look warned, with the bald tire at the bottom.

Mechanic crouches and rubs the smooth tread by hand while the driver stands beside him with a hand on his mouth, and the tire is shown at the left edge, so it focuses on checking the tread, not on warning.

Shot from inside the car over the dashboard: the driver's frightened face fills the left, the mechanic points through the window with an exclamation bubble, and the bald tire is only a cropped red band in the foreground.
Aftermath: the driver crouches with his head in his hands in distress while the mechanic comforts him, and the bald tire is on the left, so this is the latest moment with no pointing or warning.
Wide side-on shot of the whole pier running to the right, with a tiny figure at the far end shading their eyes; shows the full wooden pier and calm water, but no hourglass.

Low worm's-eye angle looking up at the pier's end, with the figure standing hands in pockets against empty sky; the water is reduced to a small sliver and the pier is cut off at the left, with no hourglass.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind, with the head and shoulder filling the left; the pier runs ahead to the end rail, and the water is a thin strip at the far left. No hourglass.
Straight top-down aerial view with the pier as a horizontal strip and the figure a tiny dot at its end; the water is the most prominent here and the figure is the least visible. No hourglass.
Tight close-up of the smiling figure resting their chin on a rail; the pier shows only as the rail and the water is a small background patch. The face is the focus and there is no hourglass.
Rear view of the figure walking away along the centered pier toward the far end, in a symmetrical, mid-stride moment; the water sits on both sides and no hourglass is visible.
Elevated view from behind and above, with the figure hunched over the end rail looking down at the water; the pier and its pilings are visible below, and there is no hourglass.
Front-facing, centered shot of the figure walking toward the viewer with hands in pockets and a relaxed smile; it shows the pier and water but cuts off the pier's far end, and has no hourglass.

Side three-quarter view of the figure standing at the pier's end with arms crossed, looking up; it is the only cell with a distant shoreline, the long pier with its pilings reflected in calm water is fully visible, and there is no hourglass.

Medium shot from the front-left with the surgeon looking down at the incision; the small yellow lightning bolt by the wall panel is visible, and the headlamp beam is lit. Head tilted more than in cell 8.

Wide, far-back shot of the whole dark operating room with IV stands, stool and tray. The surgeon is tiny, and the bolt is a small spark at far left. It shows the most room of any cell and the least detail on the face.

Low-angle close-up looking up at the surgeon's wide-eyed, focused face, with the headlamp glowing at upper right. No lightning bolt is visible, and the room is mostly cut off apart from the edge of the surgical light.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind and to the left, showing the bun, the headlamp and the instrument tray at upper right. The face is mostly hidden, there is no bolt, and the room is not shown.

Top-down overhead shot with the surgeon's head bowed and the headlamp casting a bright circle on the drape. Both hands hold instruments and the tray is at left. The face is hidden and there is no bolt.
Extreme close-up of the eyes, glasses and glowing headlamp. Nothing else is visible: no bolt, no room, no hands.

Medium shot like cell 1, but the surgeon looks up and away toward the bolt, startled, with small alert marks by the headlamp. This is the reaction moment after the surge, and the bolt is clearly visible at the left.

Side profile facing left, with a second gloved hand passing an instrument in from the right. The lamp beam is lit and the monitor shows behind. There is no lightning bolt, and the room is mostly dark.

Front medium shot with the surgeon looking down and working, in a darker room than cell 1, with the IV stand at left and the beam lit. No lightning bolt is visible, and the shot is more centered than cells 1 and 7.

Side-on, eye-level full-body lunge with the arm reaching toward the broom, which is still untouched; the corner is a flat, shallow wall seam with little depth, and it's the earliest moment alongside cell 6.
Closer, slightly low side view of a crouched sprint with the hand just short of the broom; her far leg and the corner are partly cropped, so the corner reads shallow and the full body is not shown.

High rear three-quarter view looking into a deep, clearly receding corner with the floor and both walls visible; she stretches toward the broom, the feet cut off at the bottom-left and the face mostly hidden.

Steep overhead view with motion arcs showing her lunge toward the broom; the deep corner is visible as a floor-and-wall angle, but the broom is only partly in frame at the top right and her face is hidden.
Tight close-up cropping her body to the head and arm as her hand grips the broom handle; the corner is a flat wall seam, the swing hasn't started, and the broom is large.
Medium crouch with her hand just closing on the broom handle, the full body and the corner both visible; it's the grab moment, a step after cell 2 and before cell 7.

Side view of a full lunge with her arm up on the broom handle, the broom held upright against the corner; the corner is shallow, and it's the moment just after grabbing, with more of her legs than cell 6.
Extreme close-up with her determined face and fist on the broom, the brush filling the right side; the swing and the corner are mostly cropped out, and her body is cut off.

High three-quarter view of the swing itself, a wide stance with the broom sweeping across the floor and motion arcs; the deep corner is visible behind her, and it's the latest moment, the only one where she is actually swinging.

Medium side shot of the man stretching along the branch toward a peach at upper right, before any fall; only a branch is visible, not the trunk or the full tree, so the peach tree is only partly shown.

Wide shot of the whole peach tree with the man stretching along the branch toward a far peach. It is the only picture showing the full trunk and ground, and it is the earliest moment, before the fall.
Extreme close-up of just a hand reaching for a peach. The man is mostly cut off, so neither his stretching body nor the tree is shown, and nothing is falling yet.
Close-up from a low angle with a huge peach in the foreground. The man is stretching and starting to slip, with his mouth open and one hand flung out, and part of the tree is visible.

High-angle shot from above and behind showing the man hanging head-down over the branch. He is stretching down toward a peach below, which is the only picture with the peach beneath him, and his face is hidden.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind showing his back and arm reaching up toward a peach. His face and legs are cut off and the tree is barely shown, so it reads as stretching but not falling.

Mid-action shot of the man tipping off the branch upside-down with a panicked face. Both arms flail, one peach hangs at upper right, and the trunk is mostly out of frame, so it looks like the start of the fall.
Wide shot of the man in mid-air, clearly falling, with peaches and leaves tumbling around him and the trunk on the left. It is the most dramatic fall frame and the tree is clearly in view.
Aftermath shot of the man lying dazed on the grass with stars over his head, a fallen peach beside him, and the tree above. He is neither stretching nor falling, because the fall is already over.
Eye-level wide shot of the whole frame: one bell on its frame, the ringer pulling the rope, and all four onlookers standing in a row, every face visible.
Low-angle close shot looking up past the ringer's head and arm at one big bell; the crowd is reduced to small faces along the bottom edge.
Extreme close-up of the bell and the boy's face alone; the ringer and the rest of the crowd are cut off, so the gathered crowd is hidden.
Wide shot from behind the crowd, with two woman's heads in the foreground and a hat at the edge, so their faces are hidden; the ringer and a small bell are seen far away.
Overhead bird's-eye view looking down on the bell, with the ringer and four onlookers circled around it and looking up.
Wide shot from a low-angle side view with the ringer large in the foreground pulling the rope and the crowd approaching from the left; the bell is cropped at the top.

Medium shot with the bell swinging at the top, the man in the hat covering his ears at left, and the boy and two women at the bottom; this is the only cell with the loud-noise reaction, and the ringer is absent.
Tight close-up on the ringer's face and hand on the rope, with the boy peeking over his shoulder; the bell is cropped and the rest of the crowd is cut off.
Wide shot from behind the crowd, with four backs of heads filling the foreground and the ringer and bell small in the distance; similar to cell 4 but showing the whole crowd and more of the bell.
Medium side view of a smirking clerk at a desk, sliding a ballot into the box with a stack of papers on the left; wig, clerk and box all visible, box closed and not shown overfull.
Low angle from in front of the box, with the box's front hiding the clerk's lower body; a worried clerk pushes ballots in, wig fully visible, box looks plain rather than stuffed.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind, so the wig dominates and the face is mostly hidden; the box is cropped at the right and bottom and doesn't look stuffed.

High-angle top-down view with both hands cramming ballots into the slot, loose ballots on the desk (left and right); box mostly visible and the ballots look overstuffed, but the bottom edge is cut off.
Extreme close-up on a grimacing face with tongue out and ballots in hand; wig cropped at the top, box only a thin strip at the bottom, so the box's fullness is hidden.
Full-body side view in a room, nervous clerk leaning over the box; whole wig and the entire box shown, but only a few ballots, so it doesn't look stuffed.
Front view, both hands pressing down on ballots that overflow the slot, so the box reads as full; wig and clerk fully shown, with the box centred and complete.
Tight profile from the left, with the clerk's face squeezed in and the box cropped at the right; ballots barely poking in, wig partly cut off at the left and top.

Box lid is propped open, showing the box crammed with loose papers, the best view of the stuffed or fixed box; a sweating clerk holds the lid and the wig is shown, but the box's bottom left is cut off.
Low rear view of two hikers climbing a slope toward the house, with a fairly large house and no ridge line beyond it; rain falling, and the people are shown from behind.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of a red-hooded hiker's back that blocks half the frame; the house is large and the people are mostly hidden, with no second person visible and no ridge.
High aerial view looking down on the house, the path and two tiny hikers, with the sea and the ridge edge visible; the only shot that shows the whole ridge top and the house tiny.
Close-up of a hiker's face shielding their eyes, with the house tiny in the distance on a ridge; only one person shown, and the moment is before they reach the house.
Close-up of the two hikers at the door as one grabs the knocker; the house is cut off to a wall and door, with no ridge or landscape visible, and the roof drips.
Wide, low-angle shot with the house large on the right and the two hikers tiny, far off at the left; the ridge is only a grass slope and the rain is lighter.
Tight close-up of the two smiling hikers under the eave, now sheltered and showing no sign of being soaked; the house is cropped to a wall and window, with only a sliver of rain at top right.
Interior doorway view from inside the house, with both hikers smiling in the doorway after arriving and the distant ridge and rain beyond; the house is cut off to the door frame.
Dynamic mid-shot of the two hikers rushing and slipping on the muddy path toward the door, with the house cut off to a wall and door; faces are alarmed, rain falls, and there is no ridge.
Full-length side view of the man bent forward mid-knock, fist on the door with the cat seated below; his whole body shows, but no "Carl" nametag is visible.
Tight close-up of the fist mid-knock and the cat's tilted face at the bottom corner; the man is cropped to arm and fist, so there is no nametag.
Cat dominates the foreground, big and head-tilted, while the man is small, seen from behind and knocking in the background; his back is turned, so no nametag.
High overhead shot looking down on the man's hair and shoulders and the cat on the mat; fist raised, but his chest is hidden, so no nametag.
Extreme close-up of the cat's tilted face filling the frame; the man is a small figure from behind at upper right, so no nametag.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the man's head and sweater, fist at right and cat small in the distance; his back is to us, so no nametag.
Cat is front and centre in a straight-on full-body view with a question mark over its head; the man is cropped to a fist and sleeve at top right, so no nametag.
Dramatic low-angle view with the man leaning in from the right, mouth open and fist pulled back, cat small at left; his torso is partly cropped, so no nametag shows.
Man kneeling on the floor, smiling, one hand knocking and the other on the floor, with the cat seated at right; his chest is in view, but no nametag shows.
Straight-on medium shot of the convict smirking and writing at a desk; the TV sits small and distant on a stage behind him, and the check mark is visible, but there's no A+ grade.
Low-angle shot looking up at the smirking convict, with the pencil in the foreground and a large TV at right; the paper is cropped at the bottom edge, and the check mark shows no A+.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind, so the convict's face is hidden (no smile visible); it shows the paper and the TV clearly at upper right, and he's writing.
High overhead shot looking down on the convict hunched over the desk, grinning; the TV is cut off in the top-right corner, so it's barely visible, and the paper shows a check mark but no A+.

Tight close-up of the sweating, smirking face holding the paper up toward the viewer; the TV is cropped at the right edge, and the striped uniform is mostly cut off. The check mark is large and clear, but there's no A+.

Side or three-quarter view of the convict walking past a "LIVE" sign, holding the paper up while the TV is seen through a doorway; it's the only cell with the LIVE sign, and the stripes are partly visible.
Wide shot with the convict behind a lit podium under a spotlight, writing; the TV is cropped at the right edge, and the paper lies flat on the podium.
Triumphant moment with a raised fist and a wide, beaming grin, holding up the paper with the check mark; it's the most celebratory cell, and the TV is partly cropped at the bottom right.
Medium shot of the convict writing at a cluttered desk with extra loose papers (nothing like this in the other cells); the TV is visible at upper right, and he smirks rather than celebrates.

Medium shot from the front, with the whole tall hat, the pot and a rising steam wisp all in frame. The chef cocks his head and smirks while stirring, with the spoon tip just in the soup. It also shows a hanging pan and shelves, which most others lack.

Close, low-angle shot. The spoon is lifted out of the pot and dripping soup, and the pot is cut off at the bottom, so the bubbling surface is hidden. The hat's top is nearly touching the edge, and the chef looks sideways with a scheming smirk.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind-right. The chef looks back at the viewer with a devious smirk, and the tall hat is fully visible. The pot is cropped at the left, with the spoon stirring and steam rising, so the soup is only partly seen.

High overhead, top-down angle. The swirling soup fills the lower half, with the spoon stirring, and the chef looks up at the viewer. The hat is tilted and the pot is seen from above, which no other cell shows.

Extreme close-up on the face and shoulders. The hat top is cropped, and the pot is nearly out of frame except for a sliver of soup at the bottom. The spoon handle is held in the foreground, and the smirk and head cock are the main focus.

Medium shot with the chef leaning in and the head cocked. He covers his mouth or nose with his hand, as if snickering or sniffing, while stirring with the other hand. The hat is fully visible and the pot is mostly visible, but the soup is barely seen.

Side profile close-up. The chef sniffs or tastes a spoonful of dripping soup, and the hat is cropped at the top and left. The pot is partly cut off at the left with a long steam wisp, and the spoon is held up instead of stirring.

Tight shot dominated by the spoon stirring the swirling soup in the foreground. The chef's hat is heavily cropped at the top right, and the pot is only a rim and soup, with no steam. The smirk is visible.

Front medium shot where the chef holds a paper (a recipe) in his other hand and looks sideways at it, with a window behind. The expression is more skeptical than devious. The tall hat, spoon and pot with steam are all visible, and he is the only one holding a note.
Medium shot with the person in frame: shocked face, reaching toward the tipped mug as coffee pours out; spoon lies by the mug and the desk is partly covered in coffee, laptop and papers at the edges.

Extreme close-up of the desk edge: mug cut off at top left, spoon on the desk, coffee flooding over the edge in thick drips, a hand grabbing papers at right; no person's face and the whole desk is not shown.

High overhead view: mug tipped at top left, spoon lying clear on the desk beside it, and a big coffee puddle spreading across the desk toward the laptop and papers; no person, calm moment after the spill.
Tight close-up of the mug mouth with coffee pouring out and the spoon flying through the air at top right; desk barely visible and mostly cut off, with a sliver of a face at the bottom edge.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the person, who reaches a hand into the coffee; mug and spoon are small and far at the top, the desk is covered in coffee, and the person's head and back hide part of the desk.
Low, desk-level side view: mug tipped at left, spoon in the middle of a large puddle, and coffee flooding across the desk and dripping off the front edge; no person, with the chair behind.
Close-up of the mug with a hand holding the spoon at top left, coffee still pouring out of the tipped mug onto a small puddle; the desk is only a sliver and the person is not shown beyond the hand.

Side view from the end of the desk: person leaning in with an alarmed face and a '!' speech bubble, mug and spoon at the far desk edge with coffee falling to the floor; desk is shown but only a thin stream of coffee, not a flooded surface.

Wide full-room shot: the whole desk, chair, window and person standing back with raised hands; mug tipped at the far end, coffee flooding the desk and dripping onto a rug below; spoon is too small to see clearly.

Medium close-up of the waiter, who is leaning back with both hands splayed open, while the mustard bottle tumbles upside-down above his hand and a plate edge shows at the bottom; his red face and sweat are clearly visible.

Wide shot of the whole restaurant, showing the waiter at full height mid-stumble with the bottle flying high and a seated diner at right; his face is tiny, and this is the only one that shows the lamp and the full room.
Low angle looking up at the waiter's face and both reaching hands, with a huge bottle overhead streaming mustard in an arc; it cuts off his body, and the bottle is the largest it appears in any cell.
Extreme close-up of the waiter's wide-eyed, sweating face with one hand gripping the bottle, which squirts mustard upward; his body is cropped out and no tray, plate or room appears.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the seated diner, showing the waiter in the background clutching his chest while the bottle flips through the air at left; his face is small, and the diner's back takes up much of the frame.

Tight close-up with the bottle held diagonally in one hand, squirting mustard to the upper left while his other hand grabs at it; his face is cropped at the forehead and the bottle is nearer to the camera than in cell 7.

Side-profile medium shot of the waiter gripping the bottle high in one hand while mustard drips from the nozzle, his other hand reaching down toward a table; it's the earliest moment, before the bottle is lost.

Full-length shot of the waiter standing in the aftermath, splattered with mustard, with the bottle lying empty on the floor; the only cell where the bottle has landed on the ground and he is not flipping it.

Top-down view of a plate with the bottle landed in a mustard splat, between a fork and knife; only his hands and a sliver of his red, sweating face are visible at the left edge, so he is mostly cut off.
Medium shot of the king strutting out of the castle doorway, with a banner, helmet and broken sword on the ground. Crown, pajamas and slippers are all visible. No nametag is visible.
Wide shot of the king strutting from the castle toward a battlefield with a white flag and wreckage. It shows the most setting of any cell. The king is small and has no visible nametag.
Low-angle, close view of the king mid-stride, with a huge slipper in the foreground and the castle tower at the left. It cuts off his legs and feet, and no nametag is visible.
Rear three-quarter view of the king from behind, facing a crowd of shocked soldiers and a white flag. The crown and pajamas show, but his face and chest are hidden, so any nametag is hidden too.
High overhead angle looking down on the king strutting along a stone corridor. It shows crown, pajamas and slippers, but no nametag and no battlefield.
Extreme close-up of the smiling bearded face and crown. It cuts off nearly all the pajamas and the body, and no nametag is visible.
Side profile, full-body shot of the king in mid-stride on the battlefield, with a plain background and debris. It's the clearest strut, and no nametag is visible.
Close-up of the stepping slipper and striped pajama legs beside a helmet and broken sword. It cuts off the king's head, crown and torso, so it shows no king, crown or nametag.

Front view of the king waving with one hand on his hip, surrounded by soldiers watching. Soldiers in the foreground partly block the view. It's a posed moment rather than a stride, and no nametag is visible.
Straight-on medium-wide shot with the whole perch top and post visible, an orange bird singing with wing raised between four grey birds on a hill-and-lake backdrop; no "category" sign is visible.
Low angle looking up the thick tapering post to the perch, so it feels high; the orange bird's wing is raised and three grey birds sit beside it, with only sky and clouds behind; no sign.
Tight close-up of the singing orange bird with partial grey birds at the edges and the perch cut off at the bottom; the perch's height is lost and no sign is visible.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind three large grey birds in the foreground, looking at the orange bird with its wing out; the perch is mostly hidden by the birds and there is no sign.
Top-down bird's-eye view of the round perch with the orange bird facing three grey birds, all looking up; the ground, river and trees far below show the height, but no sign.
Low-angle medium shot with the orange bird's eyes closed as it sings, one grey bird lifting a wing and a fifth bird partly hidden between them; the perch is cropped at the bottom and shows no sign.
Extreme wide shot with a tiny perch on a very tall thin pole above the lake and hills, so the height is clearest here, but the birds are tiny specks and no sign is visible.
Eye-level medium shot of the perch with a wider tabletop, the orange bird singing in the middle-left and two grey birds on each side; the post is cut off and no sign is visible.
Close low-angle shot with the perch edge cropped, the orange bird looking up with beak open and three grey birds packed beside it; no sign is visible and the post is barely visible.
Wide side-on shot of the woman standing and pointing at the dog in its kennel, with the cat (cell 2) and rabbit (cell 3) on either side. She is full-length and no shelter sign shows.
Low side view of the woman crouching to pet the freed puppy, with the cat and rabbit cut off at the edges. Her face is in profile and the shelter building is only implied by the kennels.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the woman, whose head and back fill the lower left. She points at the dog in its kennel between the cat and rabbit, and her face is hidden.
High-angle overhead shot looking down on the woman's head and shoulders as the puppy runs toward her outstretched hand. The cat and rabbit sit in kennels at the sides, and her face is hidden.
Extreme close-up of the woman's smiling face on the left, with the dog's fur blurred in the foreground. The cat, rabbit and shelter are not visible, and the dog is only partly shown.
Close-up of the dog's face between the kennel bars with a hand reaching in from the right. The woman is reduced to a hand, with the cat and rabbit small in the background and no building visible.
Front-on shot of the woman hugging the dog, her eyes closed, with the cat and rabbit in kennels behind her. It is the moment after choosing, with no shelter sign and no door.

Side view of the woman crouching to pet the dog as it steps out of its opened kennel door, with the cat and rabbit still in their kennels. The door is a unique detail, and the full-length woman and the whole dog are visible.
Final moment: the woman walks out carrying the happy dog, with a "SHELTER" sign, the cat, the rabbit and an open glass door behind her. It is the only cell that clearly shows the shelter building.
Wide, eye-level view of the satchel on dry-looking ground with only small puddles; it looks the least soaked, with few drips and a muted sky, and the whole bag and strap are in frame.
Low, close three-quarter view with the satchel sitting in a rain-pocked flooded puddle; the bag is cropped at the left and bottom, and heavy streaks and drops fill the frame.

High top-down view into the open satchel, showing rations, bottle and a tin (the others don't show the tin) standing in water. The flap is open, so the soaked rations are plainly visible, but there's no sky.
Eye-level view with a canvas tent filling the background; the satchel is dripping, with a small puddle at its base and only light rain visible.
Extreme close-up of the flap and buckle with water streaming and dripping off; rations and bottle are cropped at the top, the strap and puddle are cut off, and there's almost no rain or sky.
Eye-level view with a wooden fence behind the satchel and a rippling puddle in front; the bag is wet and dripping, and the rain is moderate.

High-angle view with the satchel tipped open and three ration packs spilled out into the puddle, plus a tin and bottle; the bag is the least waterlogged-looking here, there's no sky and the rain is only light.
Wide eye-level view of the dripping satchel in a puddle with a field and tree line behind it; rations and bottle are visible, the strap is in frame, and rain and ripples are clear.

Tight, slightly low view with the satchel filling the frame, water pouring off the flap, and the strap partly cut off; it shows the rations and bottle at the top edge and dense rain and ripples around the base.

Full-length, eye-level side-on shot of the whole room: the sinner stands at left, hand to mouth and looking at the mirror, and the whole mirror stands at right with the twin in a gentle open-handed gesture. The twin's mouth is open, but the sinner's mouth is covered.

Tilted low-angle shot looking up, with the mirror frame slanted. The sinner is cut off at the legs and the twin at the waist. The twin points a finger up (like cell 7 and cell 8), and the sinner's hand covers their mouth.

Tight close-up over the sinner's shoulder: we see the back of their head, and their face is hidden, so the sinner is not seen watching. The twin has an open, speaking mouth and open-handed gestures, and the mirror frame is mostly cropped out.

High-angle overhead view looking down on the sinner's hunched back, with their face hidden and the mirror tilted. The twin is full-length with open arms and a speaking mouth, and this is the only view from above.
